Fixed 2026-08-12 by branching on the filtered result -- large keeps the level-2 retention and the replacement pose, binary returns to the root through reset_to_root -- and letting the shared rewrite primitive install the binary (its ReplaceOutcome path already handles unit and refutation too). The LRAT chain is still walked before any backtrack, since it reads the conflict and the trail positions this propagation produced.
